lines: The hosts analyze Rollins (ROL), noting that its high recurring revenue and route density create a powerful compounding model, yet its valuation remains under pressure.
Kyle Grieve and Shawn O'Malley explain that the rise of AI-driven search tools is disrupting traditional customer acquisition channels, forcing management to rethink lead generation.
The speakers highlight that Rollins maintains a capital-expenditure requirement of less than 1% of revenue while delivering a return on invested capital of approximately 25%.
They caution that even a durable business with significant family ownership can become a poor investment if the market price assumes unsustainable growth perfection.
podcast: The Investor's Podcast (We Study Billionaires)  - The Investor’s Podcast Network
title: TIP864: Rollins (ROL): Can You Still Make a Killing in Pest Control? w/ Kyle Grieve & Shawn O'Malley
